description: use_observable/1 resolves the server argument (atom, pid, {:via,...}, factory fn) to a pid and returns it. Returns nil when subscribe_enabled is false (disconnected HTTP render). Factory fn lifecycle stays here — pid is reused while alive, restarted on death. Subscription is created only if this is the first use_projection for {owner_pid, server_pid, request} in this LiveView. Drop :project and :disconnected opts — those move to use_projection. Hook slot stores {:subscribed, server_pid} or :uninitialized.
title: Refactor use_observable/1 to return pid only
